title: Deliver the role and conditional depth to the worker
when: Delegating an authorized task or continuing its current phase
need: Canonical role → generated harness adapter → relevant conditional references, plus a dispatch prompt carrying item, lane, policies, project docs and QA. Before the first edit the worker must read the operation-home index and code-and-cli.md in its lane, then each home the index names before that operation; the role body and the Conduct dispatch prompt both require it. The Engineer paths are a concrete example of the role family.
surface: Role renderer + harness-native adapter + task-specific dispatch context
gap: Shared conditional references currently use Claude rendering; the accepted harness-correct access repair still needs proof. This example does not certify every role/harness combination. The operation-home read is a required instruction with no read-receipt guard, so a worker that skips it is not refused.
surface_notes: Task-specific dispatch prompt: Carries the actual item/artifacts, registered lane, resolved policies, relevant project/QA facts and role assignment. It is separate from native startup loading.
